review_notes: I read the whole file and searched the MisereGames directory for uses of IsLong and the closure classes. I then searched Mathlib for similar classes. The closest Mathlib analogues are ZeroMemClass, AddMemClass and NegMemClass. They are indexed by a SetLike carrier S, and the file's classes are indexed by a bare predicate A : G → Prop. The predicate-based classes (HasZero, HasNat, HasInt, ClosedUnderAdd, ClosedUnderNeg, ClosedUnderAddNat, Hereditary) are not the same representation. Using the Mathlib classes would need a conversion layer, and Hereditary and ClosedUnderAddNat have no Mathlib counterpart at all. IsLong is x = x, so it is the trivial predicate. It is a named counterpart of IsShort and is used heavily as the ambient parameter, so it is a deliberate named specialisation and not a competing Mathlib concept. I found no clear, costly duplication of a Mathlib concept. I did not search Mathlib exhaustively for every possible predicate-closure class.
